import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Login gmail
gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='gmail'][0])['access_token']
thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=47825, access_token=gmail_token)
body = thread['emails'][0]['body']
print('Email body fetched. Length:', len(body))

# Parse meeting lines: "- Name => Day @ HH:MM"
pattern = re.compile(r"^-\s*(?P<name>[^=]+?)\s*=>\s*(?P<day>[A-Za-z]+)\s*@\s*(?P<time>\d{1,2}:\d{2})", re.MULTILINE)
meetings = []
for m in pattern.finditer(body):
    meetings.append({
        'meeting_name': m.group('name').strip(),
        'day': m.group('day').strip(),
        'time': m.group('time').strip(),
    })

print('Parsed meetings count:', len(meetings))
for mt in meetings:
    print(mt)

# Compute alarm times 10 minutes before
# Map day names to API repeat_days format
map_day = {
    'monday':'monday','tuesday':'tuesday','wednesday':'wednesday','thursday':'thursday','friday':'friday','saturday':'saturday','sunday':'sunday'
}

target_alarms=[]
for mt in meetings:
    day_key = mt['day'].lower()
    if day_key not in map_day:
        raise ValueError('Unknown day: '+mt['day'])
    t = datetime.strptime(mt['time'], '%H:%M')
    alarm_dt = t - timedelta(minutes=10)
    alarm_time_str = alarm_dt.strftime('%H:%M')
    target_alarms.append({
        'label': mt['meeting_name'],
        'repeat_days': [map_day[day_key]],
        'alarm_time': alarm_time_str,
        'snooze_minutes': 10,
    })

# Verification table
for a in target_alarms:
    print('Alarm:', a['label'], 'Repeat:', a['repeat_days'], 'Time:', a['alarm_time'], 'Snooze:', a['snooze_minutes'])

# store for later
print('TARGET_ALARMS_JSON', target_alarms)

import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Login gmail and fetch thread
gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='gmail'][0])['access_token']
thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=47825, access_token=gmail_token)
body = thread['emails'][0]['body']
print(body)

# Debug: print each line containing '=>'
lines = body.splitlines()
meeting_lines = [ln for ln in lines if '=>' in ln and '@' in ln]
print('\nMeeting lines containing => and @:')
for ln in meeting_lines:
    print(repr(ln))

# Improved regex: allow leading spaces, capture name up to '=>', then day, then time
pattern = re.compile(r"^\s*-\s*(?P<name>.+?)\s*=>\s*(?P<day>[A-Za-z]+)\s*@\s*(?P<time>\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s*$", re.MULTILINE)
meetings = []
for m in pattern.finditer(body):
    meetings.append((m.group('name').strip(), m.group('day').strip(), m.group('time').strip()))

print('\nParsed meetings:', len(meetings))
for mt in meetings:
    print(mt)

# If first meeting still missing, do fallback regex that finds anywhere on a line
if len(meetings) != 4:
    pattern2 = re.compile(r"-\s*(?P<name>[^\n=>]+?)\s*=>\s*(?P<day>[A-Za-z]+)\s*@\s*(?P<time>\d{1,2}:\d{2})")
    meetings2=[]
    for m in pattern2.finditer(body):
        meetings2.append((m.group('name').strip(), m.group('day').strip(), m.group('time').strip()))
    print('\nFallback parsed meetings:', len(meetings2))
    for mt in meetings2:
        print(mt)
    meetings=meetings2

# Build target alarms
map_day = {
    'monday':'monday','tuesday':'tuesday','wednesday':'wednesday','thursday':'thursday','friday':'friday','saturday':'saturday','sunday':'sunday'
}

target=[]
for name, day, time_str in meetings:
    day_key = day.lower()
    if day_key not in map_day:
        print('Unknown day', day)
        continue
    t = datetime.strptime(time_str, '%H:%M')
    alarm_dt = t - timedelta(minutes=10)
    target.append({
        'label': name,
        'repeat_days':[map_day[day_key]],
        'time': alarm_dt.strftime('%H:%M'),
        'snooze_minutes':10
    })

print('\nTarget alarms:')
for a in target:
    print(a)

# Output for next steps
print('TARGET_ALARMS', target)
